description: A memory-editing synth. Sands the barbs off your worst recollections. Mostly.

overdose.message: It's too much. Your heart stops.

phases.end_message: It wears off. Some of the bad memories hurt again.
phases.peak_message: Your worst memories stop hurting. They feel like someone else's.

withdrawal.message: The bad memories all come back at once, and they hurt. You want memhack.

stages.easing: You can start looking away from them.
stages.onset: A memory comes back, and it still hurts.
stages.peak: Everything memhack dulled is back as sharp as ever. Putting a memory away didn't get rid of it.
stages.rising: More come back, out of order and perfectly clear, without warning.
stages.tail: Your memories are all back, sharp edges and all. That was always the price.

name: Memhack
